_comment: Summon pools (game spec 4, rates from V 2026-10-02). V: a summon is a scroll AND Mana, never one or the other: each summon burns one scroll of the pool (items.json, off-chain until the ERC-1155 burn is decided) and `cost_mana` MANA. Weights are per 10 000. The basic summon (unknown scroll) gives 1-4 stars: its 1-2 star monsters are off-chain, its 3-4 star monsters are NFTs. PLACEHOLDER basic rates and Mana costs. Drop rule (V, 2026-10-02): a broader pool never gives a rare outcome more often than the dedicated scroll for it (all-attributes = light & dark rates for light & dark + legendary rates for the elements). A pool may list `lanes` (elements + star_weights each, per 10 000 of the whole pool) instead of one `elements` + `star_weights`.

pools.name: Invocation de tous les attributs (4-6★, dont Lumière & Ténèbres)
pools._comment: Light & dark keep exactly the rates of the light & dark summon (4★ 7.5 %, 5★ 0.35 %, 6★ 0.05 %); the five elements keep the legendary rates for 5-6★ (6.5 %, 0.5 %). Mixing them never makes a rare monster easier to get than its own scroll.
